{{recipe}}
==Ingredients==
* 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (145 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
* ½ cup (115 g) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* ¼ cup (50 g) [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* ½ cup (100 g) white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] essence
* 1 pack (6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 170 g) semi-sweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate Chips|chocolate chips]]

==Procedure==
# Combine the flour, salt, and baking powder.
# Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] until it reaches 375°F/190°C.
# In another bowl, [[Cookbook:Creaming|cream]] the butter and sugars until light and fluffy.
# Add egg and vanilla, and [[Cookbook:Beating|beat]] until smooth.
# Mix in the flour mixture until well-blended.
# Add the chocolate chips, and stir with a wooden spoon.
# Drop the cookies onto a lightly-greased or [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]]-lined [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]] by teaspoonfuls in 2-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (5 cm) ball shapes.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 15 minutes or until the edges are light brown.
# Remove the cookies from the cookie sheet with a metal spatula, then let them cool on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|wire rack]].
